reasons: Section 26 selects California law and Section 27 fixes exclusive venue in California state/federal courts, which matches the rule's fallback position ('Delaware or California law and courts'), so a compliant classification is correct under the playbook's classification semantics.
No arbitration provision exists, so there is no foreign-seat or walk-away exposure; deterministic check confirms the governing law is within the accepted set.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the original paragraphs are left unmodified.

The rationale accurately identifies the only shortfall versus preferred (local California county venue instead of New York County) and correctly treats it as a noted sub-element rather than a deviation.
